evals.name: amplifier-online
evals.prompt: I've got a one-paragraph product vision doc for a product called Amplifier Online (the file is attached). Turn it into a pitch deck I can walk my leadership through.
evals.expected_output: A structured pitch markdown doc following the spine, and a self-contained HTML slide deck. Faithful to the vision doc, gaps flagged as [needs data], vision kept general with scope pushed to roadmap.

assertions.text: A self-contained HTML slide deck file (.html) is present in outputs.
The deck HTML has no local/relative script or stylesheet dependencies (a remote web-font <link> is allowed); it opens standalone.
The deck supports keyboard navigation (a keydown handler referencing ArrowRight/ArrowLeft).
A separate markdown pitch document (not just the deck) is present in outputs.
The deck is about Amplifier Online and does NOT leak content from Amplifier Agent.
The deck covers the core pitch beats: a problem/why-care, the product as jobs/benefits, the customer, why-win or competition, and an ask/aspiration close.
Missing specifics (market size, revenue model, team, personal 'why') are flagged as [needs data] or similar, NOT fabricated (no invented market numbers, metrics, or logos).
The opening/title slide leads with a promise or stake, not a bare product-category label.
The top-level story stays general/human; scope and implementation detail are pushed to a roadmap/appendix rather than opening the pitch.
